headerDisplay: Requires the **mergbw bridge** service running on the same network (see the README). The bridge handles the Bluetooth connection; this plugin talks to it over HTTP.

url.title: Bridge URL
url.description: Address of the mergbw bridge. Use http://127.0.0.1:8790 when it runs on the same machine as Homebridge.

mac.title: Serial number
mac.description: Optional. Shown as the serial number in the Home app (e.g. the strip's MAC address).

model.title: Model
model.description: Optional. Shown as the model in the Home app.

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to refresh the state from the bridge. Reads are local and cheap; this does not wake the Bluetooth connection.
